sentences.en: Computer manufactures, such as Hewlett Packard, allow you to send in your computer parts for recycling.

sentences.en: This model paved the way for many more household printers by companies such as Hewlett Packard, Canon, and Lexmark; the advent of home photo printers helped digital photography explode in the home market over the next decade.

sentences.en: The Monterey Bay Aquarium was opened in 1984 as a gift to the Monterey community by David Packard, a founder of Hewlett Packard, and his wife Lucile.
